scenes.title: Cold Open
scenes.spokenText: How many tabs does it take to plan a wedding? A budget spreadsheet, a checklist, a thread of vendor emails, and a deadline you forgot.
scenes.subtitleText: How many tabs does it take to plan a wedding? A budget spreadsheet, a checklist, a thread of vendor emails, and a deadline you forgot.
scenes.action: Stack of browser tab chips collapse into the Occasio wax monogram

scenes.title: Title Card
scenes.spokenText: This is Occasio. It is a planning assistant for weddings, birthdays and community events. Budget, timeline, vendors and ideas, all in one place. Let us plan a wedding.
scenes.subtitleText: This is Occasio. It's a planning assistant for weddings, birthdays and community events. Budget, timeline, vendors and ideas, all in one place. Let's plan a wedding.
scenes.action: Editorial stationery title card with Budget, Timeline, Vendors, Ideas pillars

scenes.title: Welcome & Wizard
scenes.spokenText: A hundred and twenty guests, thirty-five thousand dollars, about a year out. As you type, you can already see how the money gets split. No AI yet. Just math.
scenes.subtitleText: A hundred and twenty guests, thirty-five thousand dollars, about a year out. As you type, you can already see how the money gets split. No AI yet. Just math.
scenes.action: Select Wedding, type event name, 120 guests, 35,000 budget, watch live preview donut rebalance

scenes.title: Gemini Live Generation
scenes.spokenText: Then Gemini writes the creative parts of the plan. It never sees your event name, and you can check exactly what it does get. The totals and dates still come from tested code.
scenes.subtitleText: Then Gemini writes the creative parts of the plan. It never sees your event name, and you can check exactly what it does get. The totals and dates still come from tested code.
scenes.action: Expand exactly what is sent panel, click Generate Plan, wait for real Gemini output, hover AI live pill and provenance badge

scenes.title: Demo Mode Fallback
scenes.spokenText: If the AI is ever unavailable, or there is no key, a built-in demo engine takes over and the app tells you.
scenes.subtitleText: If the AI is ever unavailable, or there's no key, a built-in demo engine takes over and the app tells you.
scenes.action: Switch to port 3001 demo server, click Demo mode: no API key pill, show accessible popover with Check again button

scenes.title: Event Overview & Milestones
scenes.spokenText: This is your plan. A countdown, your next deadlines, and a warning if something slips. Tick one off, and you can undo it.
scenes.subtitleText: This is your plan. A countdown, your next deadlines, and a warning if something slips. Tick one off, and you can undo it.
scenes.action: Arched hero photo, countdown medallion, tick off two milestones, show undo toast notification

scenes.title: Budget Dynamic Rebalancing
scenes.spokenText: In the budget view, drag the venue up and the other categories make room. Do it again with catering. The total never changes.
scenes.subtitleText: In the budget view, drag the venue up and the other categories make room. Do it again with catering. The total never changes.
scenes.action: Navigate to Budget & Sliders, drag Venue slider up, drag Catering, show zero budget drift

scenes.title: Timeline & Backward Scheduling
scenes.spokenText: Deadlines are planned backward from the wedding date, grouped into phases. Shift one with a click, or view them on the Gantt chart.
scenes.subtitleText: Deadlines are planned backward from the wedding date, grouped into phases. Shift one with a click, or view them on the Gantt chart.
scenes.action: Timeline list view, click shift milestone stepper (+7d), toggle Gantt chart view

scenes.title: Vendor Pipeline & Questions
scenes.spokenText: Each vendor moves from first contact to booked, with the right questions to ask along the way. Enter a quote and your real spend updates.
scenes.subtitleText: Each vendor moves from first contact to booked, with the right questions to ask along the way. Enter a quote and your real spend updates.
scenes.action: Navigate to Vendor Pipeline, expand Essential Questions To Ask, change stage to Quoted, type quote, show budget ledger update

scenes.title: Creative Ideas & Regeneration
scenes.spokenText: In the ideas tab you get themes, palettes and a menu that follows your dietary needs. Not feeling one? Regenerate just that idea, and pin the ones you keep.
scenes.subtitleText: In the ideas tab you get themes, palettes and a menu that follows your dietary needs. Not feeling one? Regenerate just that idea, and pin the ones you keep.
scenes.action: Navigate to Ideas, click Regenerate this theme button, watch content refresh, click Pin theme

scenes.title: Planning Copilot & Diff
scenes.spokenText: Need to cut costs? Ask the copilot. It shows exactly what would change, and nothing happens until you confirm. And you can always undo.
scenes.subtitleText: Need to cut costs? Ask the copilot. It shows exactly what would change, and nothing happens until you confirm. And you can always undo.
scenes.action: Ask copilot to cut total budget by 10%, review color-coded parameter diff preview, click Confirm, then click Undo

scenes.title: Scenario Compare
scenes.spokenText: What if you invite fifty fewer guests? Duplicate the plan, change the number, and compare both side by side.
scenes.subtitleText: What if you invite fifty fewer guests? Duplicate the plan, change the number, and compare both side by side.
scenes.action: Navigate to Scenario Compare, click Duplicate Plan, change guest count to 70, view side-by-side comparison tables

scenes.title: Export & Portability
scenes.spokenText: Take it with you. Print the plan, export the budget as a spreadsheet and the timeline to your calendar, or save a backup file.
scenes.subtitleText: Take it with you. Print the plan, export the budget as a spreadsheet and the timeline to your calendar, or save a backup file.
scenes.action: Open Export modal, highlight Print View, Export Budget CSV, Export Calendar .ICS, and Backup JSON buttons

scenes.title: Themes & Accessibility
scenes.spokenText: Switch to a birthday or a community event and the whole look changes. Everything works from the keyboard. Control K opens a command palette, and there is a calmer mode with less decoration.
scenes.subtitleText: Switch to a birthday or a community event and the whole look changes. Everything works from the keyboard. Control K opens a command palette, and there's a calmer mode with less decoration.
scenes.action: Press Ctrl+K command palette, cycle theme to Birthday, then Community, then click Decoration Minimal toggle in sidebar footer

scenes.title: Quality Scorecard
scenes.spokenText: Under the hood, it is covered by automated tests and accessibility checks on every screen. And the API key never leaves the server.
scenes.subtitleText: Under the hood, it's covered by automated tests and accessibility checks on every screen. And the API key never leaves the server.
scenes.action: Display live scorecard with verified test passes, axe-core 0 violations, zero audit vulnerabilities, and 3.02 MB size

scenes.title: Closing Card
scenes.spokenText: That is Occasio. One place for the budget, the timeline, the vendors and the ideas. Plans are saved on your device, and the code is open source on GitHub.
scenes.subtitleText: That's Occasio. One place for the budget, the timeline, the vendors and the ideas. Plans are saved on your device, and the code is open source on GitHub.
scenes.action: Stationery closing card with repo link, Next.js 16 and Gemini model ID
